subject: Fisher`s Exact Test and DeducerRichOutput package

messages.author: 3871a2787d9649e8
messages.subject: Fisher`s Exact Test and DeducerRichOutput package
parts:
Hi!

When I run the Fisher`s Exact Test with the DeducerRichOutput package loaded/enabled the result is this error:

Error in `colnames-`(`*tmp*`, value = list(`NA` = NULL, exact = "exact p-value")) :
  length of 'dimnames' [2] not equal to array extent

If I do not load/enable the DeducerRichOutput everything is OK.

Anyone else has encountered this problem?
